mapper.select: SELECT id, config_id, user_id, trigger_type, recipient_type, channel, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_recipient WHERE config_id = #{configId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY id

SELECT r.id, r.config_id, r.user_id, r.trigger_type, r.recipient_type, r.channel, r.enabled, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM notification_recipient r JOIN notification_config c ON c.id = r.config_id WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} AND r.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY r.id

SELECT r.id, r.config_id, r.user_id, r.trigger_type, r.recipient_type, r.channel, r.enabled, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM notification_recipient r JOIN notification_config c ON c.id = r.config_id WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} AND r.trigger_type = #{triggerType} AND r.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY r.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification_recipient WHERE config_id = #{configId} AND trigger_type = #{triggerType}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notification_recipient (config_id, user_id, trigger_type, recipient_type, channel, enabled) VALUES
(#{r.configId}, #{r.userId}, #{r.triggerType}, #{r.recipientType}, #{r.channel}, #{r.enabled})
